newsitem.title: USA: Intraday CSCE world sugar up, off contract highs.
newsitem.headline: Intraday CSCE world sugar up, off contract highs.

text.p: CSCE world sugar futures were firmer but off the highs by midsession as steady trade buying eroded early gains, floor sources said.

The most-active July contract pierced resistance in brisk morning trade and continued to soar through new, life-of-contract highs, buoyed by technically-driven fund buying. Floor sources said the May contract rose easily amid thin open interest and helped lift July to the highs.
While the market is becoming overbought technically, and the trade has emerged as a seller, "the specs just keep buying," a broker said.
Ongoing talk of Russian interest may have provided support, although no new business has been confirmed, he added.

At 1125 EST, most-active July stood 0.13 cent a lb firmer at 11.25 cents per lb, having traded from a new contract high of 11.37 to 11.06. May was up 0.19 cent to 11.46 cents per lb, while the outer contracts stood 0.06 to 0.08 higher.
Support was pegged at 11.20 cents basis July.
Volume at 1100 EST was estimated to have reached a brisk 25,286 lots.
The last trading day for the May contract is April 30. Open interest stood at 35,613 lots, down 3,472 lots as of Monday's close. July gained 1,956 lots to 72,245 lots.
((-- S Rostler, New York Commodities Desk, 212 859 1640))
